messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"verses":[{"text":"Some of them also were set up, but didn’t rule.","verse":21,"chapter":11},{"text":"After this I saw, and behold, the twelve wings disappeared, along with two of the little wings.","verse":22,"chapter":11},{"text":"There was no more left on the eagle’s body, except the three heads that rested, and six little wings.","verse":23,"chapter":11},{"text":"I saw, and behold, two little wings divided themselves from the six and remained under the head that was on the right side; but four remained in their place.","verse":24,"chapter":11},{"text":"I saw, and behold, these under wings planned to set themselves up and to rule.","verse":25,"chapter":11},{"text":"I saw, and behold, there was one set up, but in a while it disappeared.","verse":26,"chapter":11},{"text":"A second also did so, and it disappeared faster than the first.","verse":27,"chapter":11},{"text":"I saw, and behold, the two that remained also planned between themselves to reign.","verse":28,"chapter":11},{"text":"While they thought about it, behold, one of the heads at rest awakened, the one that was in the middle, for that was greater than the two other heads.","verse":29,"chapter":11},{"text":"I saw how it joined the two other heads with it.","verse":30,"chapter":11},{"text":"Behold, the head turned with those who were with it, and ate the two under wings that planned to reign.","verse":31,"chapter":11},{"text":"But this head held the whole earth in possession, and ruled over those who dwell in it with much oppression. It had stronger governance over the world than all the wings that had gone before.","verse":32,"chapter":11},{"text":"After this I saw, and behold, the head also that was in the middle suddenly disappeared, like the wings.","verse":33,"chapter":11},{"text":"But the two heads remained, which also reigned the same way over the earth and over those who dwell in it.","verse":34,"chapter":11},{"text":"I saw, and behold, the head on the right side devoured the one that was on the left side.","verse":35,"chapter":11},{"text":"Then I heard a voice, which said to me, “Look in front of you, and consider the thing that you see.”","verse":36,"chapter":11},{"text":"I saw, and behold, something like a lion roused out of the woods roaring. I heard how he sent out a man’s voice to the eagle, and spoke, saying,","verse":37,"chapter":11},{"text":"“Listen and I will talk with you. The Most High will say to you,","verse":38,"chapter":11},{"text":"‘Aren’t you the one that remains of the four animals whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of my times might come through them?","verse":39,"chapter":11},{"text":"The fourth came and overcame all the animals that were past, and ruled the world with great trembling, and the whole extent of the earth with grievous oppression. He lived on the earth such a long time with deceit.","verse":40,"chapter":11}],"chapter":11,"book_code":"2ES"}
